newsitem.title: RUSSIA: PRESS DIGEST - RUSSIA IZVESTIA - MAY 7.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - RUSSIA IZVESTIA - MAY 7.

text.p: Following are some of the leading stories in the May 8 edition of Russia's Izvestia newspaper. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.

- The leadership of Moldova and the breakaway Dnestr region will sign a peace memorandum in Moscow on Thursday in the presence of the presidents of Russia and Ukraine, a representative of the OSCE and Denmark's foreign minister.
- Russians are getting confused with holidays nowadays but May 9, Victory Day, remains holiday number one, according to the latest public opinion pull.
- Two sailors have died on a Russian ship which has been held since last November in the Ukraine becasue it owes $18,000 to the Black Sea port of Yalta.
- Moscow police have arrested a man who made three bomb threats by telephone.
